text: At standard atmospheric pressure, at what temperature does pure water boil?

choices.A: The proposal has already been approved.
choices.B: The proposal was rejected because of its cost.
choices.C: The manager believes privacy is irrelevant.
choices.D: Approval is pending the privacy review.

text: I would have attended the concert if my train had not been canceled. Which conclusion is most strongly supported?

choices.B: The speaker did not attend because the train was canceled.
choices.C: The speaker never intended to attend.

text: All mavens are tutors. No tutor is a trainee. Ada is a maven. Which statement must be true?

A store has the following return policy: Within 14 days, customers with a receipt receive a full refund. After 14 days, customers with a receipt receive store credit. Without a receipt, neither option is available. A customer returns an item after 20 days and provides a valid receipt. What should the store offer?

choices.C: No compensation because the receipt is invalid.

text: Laboratory access requires both a valid employee ID badge and completed safety training. Jordan has a valid badge but has not completed the training. What is the correct decision?

choices.A: Allow entry because Jordan has a badge.
choices.B: Deny entry until the training is completed.
choices.C: Allow entry without any additional conditions.

text: A workshop requires all participants to register. Participants under 18 must also arrive with an accompanying adult. A 16-year-old participant has registered successfully but arrives alone. What is the correct outcome?

choices.B: Reject the participant because registration is missing.
choices.C: Require an accompanying adult before admission.
choices.D: Require the participant to wait until turning 18, regardless of accompaniment.

text: An automated backup policy states: Run a backup if and only if the external drive is connected and the laptop is charging. Both conditions have been confirmed. What action follows from the policy?

choices.B: Wait until the battery becomes fully charged.

choices.D: The flight arrived earlier than scheduled.

choices.B: The device should remain awake because presentation mode overrides sleep.
choices.C: The device must enter sleep mode after exactly 10 minutes.
choices.D: Presentation mode must be disabled automatically.

text: A museum offers free admission to visitors aged 12 or younger. Visitors aged 13 or older must purchase a standard ticket. What applies to a visitor who is exactly 12 years old?

choices.C: The visitor is classified as an adult.

choices.C: Both the draft and final version.

text: A rental agreement requires equipment to be returned within 72 hours of checkout. A device is checked out on Monday at 10:00 AM and returned on Thursday at 9:00 AM. Is the return on time?
